title: 2v2 Box game
setup: Two squares set apart from each other, a team of two on each side. One ball. Can also be played with just two people.
instructions: Hit the ball over to the other team's square, keeping it below knee height.
Whoever the ball comes to takes a touch and kills it for their partner.
Their partner then does the same: hits the ball over to the other square.
A team loses the point if they cannot get the ball into the opposite square, their touch escapes the square, or they mess up.
Keep playing to 7, 11, or whatever score you choose.
coachingPoints: Keep the ball below knee height.
Take a touch that sets up your partner.
You constantly receive a difficult ball and work on your passing, with a game and team aspect added.
